basic_details.job_title: TMC MPMMCC Ad-hoc Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (TMC MPMMCC) has announced 1 vacancy for the Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Haemato-pathology) post on a contract basis in Varanasi. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 4 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM, while outstation candidates may send a single PDF resume by 2 November 2026. The notified pay ranges from Rs. 1,28,000 to Rs. 1,52,000, with remuneration varying by qualification and years of experience. Eligible applicants must hold DM (Hematopathology) or MD/DNB (Pathology) with 3 years experience, subject to an age limit of 45 years

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 45 years.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: DM (Hematopathology) or equivalent post graduate degree in Hematopathology recognized by National Medical Commission. OR M.D. / D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent post graduate degree recognised by National Medical Commission.

qualification.details: For D.M.: Experience not required. For M.D./ D.N.B: 3 years post MD / DNB experience as a senior resident in a Hematopathology Laboratory with exposure in Bone Marrow morphology. Flow cytometry, molecular techniques related to Hematological malignancies. Candidates with less than 3 years experience will be considered for a lower grade, if there are no suitably experienced candidates. Experience in Minimal residual disease detection and molecular techniques like Next generation sequencing will be an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: About TMC MPMMCC Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Haemato-pathology)
content_sections.text: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre & Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital in Varanasi conducts recruitment to appoint qualified medical professionals. This position of Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Haemato-pathology) is for a period of six months or till the occupancy of regular post, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: For D.M.: Experience not required. For M.D./ D.N.B: 3 years post MD / DNB experience as a senior resident in a Hematopathology Laboratory with exposure in Bone Marrow morphology. Flow cytometry, molecular techniques related to Hematological malignancies. Candidates with less than 3 years experience will be considered for a lower grade, if there are no suitably experienced candidates. Experience in Minimal residual disease detection and molecular techniques like Next generation sequencing will be an added advantage.

rows.qualification_required: DM (Hematopathology) or equivalent post graduate degree in Hematopathology recognized by National Medical Commission. OR M.D. / D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent post graduate degree recognised by National Medical Commission.
rows.pay: Rs. 1,28,000/- to Rs. 1,52,000/- depending on qualification and years of experience

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years .

content_sections.heading: TMC MPMMCC Ad-hoc Medical Officer (Haemato-pathology) Job Description
content_sections.text: The academic designation such as Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor etc. will be conferred to the candidate(s) after joining TMC, as per the National Medical Commission Norms.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph PAN card Aadhar card Educational certificates in Original Experience certificates in Original One set of self-attested copies of certificates

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to carry their bio-data, recent passport size photograph, PAN card, Aadhar card, educational and experience certificates in Original and one set of self-attested copies on given date for attending interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for the TMC MPMMCC Ad-hoc Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on Wednesday, 04th November 2026 (between 09.00 AM to 10.00 AM).
